name: Necromancer: Animated Zombies emit Zombie Plague while they fight
contract: Animate: Zombie 525379 summons creature 503031 and reads 'These minions cause periodic Nature Damage to nearby enemies while active.' Spell.dbc gives the Zombies' passive Zombie Plague 504023 a periodic trigger of Zombie Plague 504022 every 3000 ms ('Deals ${$504022m1+$504022ppl1+$SP*.1} Plague Damage'). Nothing applied or emulated it, so a fighting Zombie only meleed and never cast 504022. A fighting Zombie now casts 504022 on the passive's period, and an idle one does not.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and the Life Force aura settle
Idle for more than one plague period
CONTROL: an idle Zombie emits no Zombie Plague
DISCRIMINATING: the fighting Zombie emits Zombie Plague
